data.name: Damarion
data.gender_notes: Damarion is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'Damas' (tamed) and 'Rion' (mountain). The name Damarion signifies 'God's tamed mountain'. In the Bible, this name is not explicitly mentioned, but it may be derived from the name Damascus, which is believed to mean 'tamed' or 'subdued'. The name Damarion carries the meaning “God's tamed mountain” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Damarion usually hope their child will grow to embody god's tamed mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of strength and submission to God.
data.etymology: Damarion belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's tamed mountain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Damarion total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

Additionally, it can serve as a reminder that with the power of God, one can conquer even the toughest of mountains.
